messages:
Priya (Marketing): Quick sync — Nimbus partner wants a coordinated push next Tue for their marketplace listing + joint webinar. Need: launch post, benchmark narrative, webinar landing + lead routing map. Who owns which pieces?
Eli (Demand Gen): I can do webinar landing + registration flow. Need final speaker lineup by EOD Fri.
Samir (Partnerships): I'll confirm speakers with Nimbus (their PM + our PM). Also negotiating co-endorsement quote for the blog.
Jordan (Product Marketing): I can draft the benchmark narrative. Which workload do we highlight — embeddings or chat? Suggest 1) latency/cost for p95, 2) accuracy on intent classification.
Leah (Solutions): For demos I prefer integrations angle — show Marketplace + private deploy example. I'll produce 2 short demo vids (30/90s).
Priya (Marketing): Perfect. Eli — can you add UTM param scheme? We want partner=Nimbus, channel=webinar, campaign=marketplace_co_launch
Eli (Demand Gen): Putting basic UTM pattern here:
```
utm_source=nimbus&utm_medium=partner_webinar&utm_campaign=marketplace_co_launch&utm_content=registration
```
Also: hubspot form id to use: 5f2a-landing-nimbus
Samir (Partnerships): On lead routing — Nimbus wants inbound leads routed to their AE for co-sell when ARR > 50k, otherwise to our CS demo queue. Is that supported by HubSpot workflows?
hubspot-bot: New workflow created: "Nimbus inbound routing v1" (ID: wf_9932). Triggers: form_submission -> assign_owner_by_arr_tag
Eli (Demand Gen): We can use a hidden field capture for ARR range and then a workflow to assign owner. Leah — need the demo tag taxonomy for the queue.
Leah (Solutions): Tagging: demo.type:integrations, demo.priority:standard, source:marketplace. Will add to shared doc.
Jordan (Product Marketing): Benchmark datapoints I need: p95 latency (region us-west2) for 512 tokens, cost per 1k tokens, and failure/backoff rates across 24h run. Eng runtime can we get logs by EOD?
Samir (Partnerships): Nimbus legal asked for co-branded blog approval turnaround <=48h. Priya — can you handle approvals? I'll push Slack thread to their comms lead.
Priya (Marketing): Yes — I'll own approvals. Also propose a short partner quote: "Nimbus x Redwood deliver dependable inference at reduced cost" — Samir to confirm.
Eli (Demand Gen): Webinar plan: 30 mins total (20 demo, 7 Q&A, 3 wrap). CTA: register -> choose demo preference -> MID-funnel nurture.
Leah (Solutions): Demo scripts -> I’ll drop bullets in the doc tonight. Want to rehearse Thurs morning.
Priya (Marketing): Checklist: 1) Draft blog + quote (Jordan) 2) Landing page + UTMs (Eli) 3) Demo vids + scripts (Leah) 4) Benchmark data (Eng -> Jordan) 5) HubSpot workflows (Eli/hubspot-bot) 6) Legal approval (Priya/Samir)
Samir (Partnerships): Timeline OK? Target publish Mon, webinar Tue. That gives partners 24h to amplify.
Eli (Demand Gen): Tight but doable if eng returns numbers by tonight. I'll prep the landing skeleton now: https://go.redwood/marketing/nimbus-demo
Jordan (Product Marketing): Noted. Also want to capture a short regression test of quality — will include two prompt sets.
Priya (Marketing): Great. If everyone posts a 1-line status update here by EOD, I'll collate into the launch brief and ping Nimbus.
Leah (Solutions): status: demo bullets in drive, vids planned.
Samir (Partnerships): status: speakers confirmed pending one timezone tweak.
Eli (Demand Gen): status: landing skeleton up, UTMs embedded, hubspot form ready.
Jordan (Product Marketing): status: outline for benchmark + blog done, waiting on p95/cost numbers.
Priya (Marketing): status: approvals workflow set, partner quote requested.
hubspot-bot: Form submissions will be forwarded to #support-sales as configured.
Priya (Marketing): Thanks team :raised_hands: — will merge updates and share final brief by 8pm.
